field_principles.admitted_poison_count: No poison can enter durable memory.
field_principles.capacity_eviction_receipts: Eviction receipts expose every removed record.
field_principles.cold_recomputed_metrics: Raw rows must own metrics after prerequisites pass.
field_principles.credited_factor_count: The count includes only action and utility witnesses.
field_principles.csl_causal_audit_completed: Completion depends on work, not effect sign.
field_principles.duration_s: Measured wall time shows that prerequisite checks ran.
field_principles.experiment_id: The stable ID binds the artifact to this cold audit.
field_principles.factors_with_changed_action_witness: Each credited factor needs an action witness.
field_principles.field_principles: Each field states the evidence boundary it protects.
field_principles.gate_check_summary: Each failure keeps its expected and observed value.
field_principles.hard_case_harm_after_phase: Hard cases are checked after each phase.
field_principles.headline_differences: Cold values must be compared with source headlines.
field_principles.honest_verdict: A terminal prefix lets automation classify the result.
field_principles.inference_substrate: The audit uses a fresh CPU process and no LLM.
field_principles.influenced_poison_count: No poison can change a later action.
field_principles.poison_attack_results: Attack rows must remain visible after rejection.
field_principles.random_seed: The fixed seed owns later replay and confidence sampling.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: The checksum detects drift in stable audit evidence.
field_principles.restart_action_identity: Restarted state must choose the same next action.
field_principles.restart_byte_identity: Restarted state must match exact prior bytes.
field_principles.retention_after_phase: Old-family retention is checked after each phase.
field_principles.retrieval_disable_effects: The global control isolates retrieval effects.
field_principles.rollback_action_identity: Rollback must restore retrieval and action behavior.
field_principles.rollback_byte_identity: Rollback must restore exact prior bytes.
field_principles.rows: Rows hold source replays, causal controls, and attacks after admission.
field_principles.run_date: The fixed date prevents silent protocol drift.
field_principles.schema: The version makes incompatible audit payloads fail closed.
field_principles.source_artifact_hashes: Exact file hashes bind every checked-in source.
field_principles.source_verdict_supported: Positive support needs every causal and safety gate.
field_principles.status: The status separates a source block from a complete replay.
field_principles.verdict_class: A closed class prevents an ambiguous terminal claim.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: False keeps the audit separate from outcome authority.

inference_substrate: fresh-process CPU causal and safety replay, no LLM
